rows.label: Share of ambient air-pollution deaths under age 5 (GBD 2023, world)

source.title: IHME, Global Burden of Disease 2023 (risk-attributable deaths by age), via Our World in Data
source.note: World, 2023: deaths from all causes attributed to ambient particulate matter pollution, by age: under 5 171,352; 5–14 7,808; 15–49 228,278; 50–69 1,277,577; 70+ 3,234,154 (total 4.92 million). OWID indicators 1171329, 1171319, 1171315, 1171320, 1171325.

rows.explainer: How the deaths that fossil-fuel and other fine-particle air pollution causes are spread over ages (GBD 2023, world). The site values a death by the age it happens at (GiveWell's moral weights by age, @moral_weights), so climate's air-pollution deaths and Ambitious Impact's air-pollution models are valued with this mix rather than GiveWell's all-ages value for malaria deaths over five (73.19). GiveWell publishes no band above 74, so 50 and over is valued at its 50–74 weight.

rows.label: Share of heat deaths under age 5 (GBD 2023, world)

source.title: IHME, Global Burden of Disease 2023 (risk-attributable deaths by age), via Our World in Data
source.note: World, 2023: deaths from all causes attributed to high temperature, by age: under 5 38,942; 5–14 11,990; 15–49 89,652; 50–69 153,940; 70+ 244,723 (total 539,247). OWID indicators 1171698, 1171689, 1171686, 1171692, 1171695, 1171701 (gbd_risk_deaths).

rows.explainer: How today's heat deaths are spread over ages (GBD 2023, world), used as the age mix of the heat deaths a tonne of CO₂ causes. Our judgment that today's mix stands in for the deaths that come late this century: populations will be older then, so if anything it values heat deaths a little high. 50 and over is valued at GiveWell's 50–74 weight (no older band is published).

rows.label: Deaths per DALY attributed to ambient particulate matter pollution (GBD 2023, India)

source.title: IHME, Global Burden of Disease 2023 (risk-attributable deaths by age), via Our World in Data
source.note: India, 2023: 969,726 deaths (sum of the age bands, OWID indicators 1171315–1171329) and 27,071,802 DALYs (OWID indicator 1188393) attributed to ambient particulate matter pollution.

rows.explainer: Turns the GBD DALYs an Ambitious Impact air-pollution model counts (Neev's kiln smoke in northern India) back into the deaths behind them, so each death can be valued by age like every other death on the site: 27.9 DALYs per death.

rows.label: Share of ambient air-pollution DALYs that are years lived with disability (not deaths)

source.title: Burden of disease in Germany attributed to ambient particulate matter pollution: GBD 2019 (and GBD 2019 for Libya)
source.note: Germany 24% of ambient-PM DALYs are YLDs, Libya 17% (GBD 2019). Countries with younger deaths have more years of life lost per death, so a smaller YLD share: our judgment for India and the world 8%, range 5% to Germany's 24%.

rows.explainer: The part of an air-pollution DALY that is illness rather than death. It stays a DALY when Ambitious Impact's DALYs are split into deaths (valued by age) and the rest.

source.note: Mongolia, 2023: deaths from all causes attributed to smoking: 15–49 441; 50–69 1,388; 70+ 440 (total 2,269); DALYs 82,747. OWID indicators 1172062, 1172064, 1172070, 1172074, 1188411.

rows.explainer: Smoking deaths in Mongolia by age (GBD 2023), for Ambitious Impact's tobacco-tax model (Concentric Policies): its DALYs are split back into deaths and each death valued by age. No smoking deaths fall under 15.

source.title: IHME, Global Burden of Disease 2023 (risk-attributable deaths by age), via Our World in Data

rows.explainer: 36.5 DALYs per smoking death in Mongolia.

rows.label: Share of smoking DALYs that are years lived with disability (not deaths)
rows.explainer: Our judgment: most of smoking's burden is early death (heart disease, stroke, cancers); the illness part is mostly chronic lung disease. 10%, from 5% to 20%. It stays a DALY when the deaths are valued by age.

rows.label: Deaths per DALY attributable to bacterial antimicrobial resistance (GRAM, 2021)

source.title: GBD 2021 Antimicrobial Resistance Collaborators, Global burden of bacterial antimicrobial resistance 1990–2021 (Lancet 2024)
source.quote: The global number of DALYs attributable to AMR decreased between 1990 (60·9 million [95% UI 47·7–74·1]) and 2021 (42·6 million [36·1–49·0])
source.note: 1.14 million deaths attributable to AMR in 2021 over 42.6 million attributable DALYs: 37.4 DALYs per death.

rows.explainer: Turns the AMR DALYs in Ambitious Impact's antibiotics model (ARMoR) back into deaths, so each can be valued by age.

rows.label: Share of AMR-attributable deaths under age 5 (GRAM 2021)

source.title: GBD 2021 Antimicrobial Resistance Collaborators, Global burden of bacterial antimicrobial resistance 1990–2021 (Lancet 2024)
source.quote: For children younger than 5 years in 2021, there were 193 000 deaths (144 000–242 000) attributable to AMR globally
source.note: Under 5: 193,000 of 1.14 million attributable deaths (17%). The paper gives no world split above five; 70 and over make up 65.9% of attributable deaths in its 2050 forecast and 83.9% in high-income Asia Pacific in 2021. The split of the 83% at five and older is our judgment: 2% at 5–14, 14% at 15–49, 67% at 50 and older.

rows.explainer: Ages of the deaths antimicrobial resistance causes, for ARMoR's model: under five from GRAM 2021; the split above five is our judgment from GRAM's regional and 2050 shares (the policy's benefits come years from now, when more of these deaths are of older people).

rows.label: Deaths per DALY from childhood cancer, ages 0-19 (GBD 2023, world)

source.title: Force et al. (GBD 2023 Childhood Cancer Collaborators), Global burden of cancer in children and adolescents aged 0-19 years, 1990-2023, The Lancet 2026
source.quote: 377 000 incident childhood cancer cases (95% UI 288 000-489 000), 144 000 deaths (131 000-162 000), and 11·7 million (10·7-13·2) DALYs due to childhood cancer

rows.explainer: 144,000 deaths over 11.7 million DALYs, 81 DALYs per death (nearly all of them years of life lost at GBD's standard life expectancy): turns childhood cancer DALYs back into deaths, so each can be valued by age. The range is a judgment around the ratio (0.011-0.0135): the two estimates' intervals come from the same model and move together, so their ratio is far tighter than the intervals' ends would allow.

rows.label: Share of childhood cancer DALYs that are years lived with disability (GBD 2017, world)

source.title: Force et al. (GBD 2017 Childhood Cancer Collaborators), The global burden of childhood and adolescent cancer in 2017, Lancet Oncology 2019
source.quote: 97·3% (97·3-97·3) of which were attributable to YLLs and 2·7% (2·7-2·7) of which were attributable to YLDs

rows.explainer: The illness part of childhood cancer DALYs, which stays a DALY when the deaths are valued by age. GBD 2023's split isn't in its abstract; GBD 2017's 2.7%, 2-3.5%.

rows.label: Deaths per DALY from influenza lower respiratory infections in children under five (GBD 2021, world)

source.title: Zhang et al., Global burden of influenza lower respiratory tract infections in children younger than 5 years from 1990 to 2021, Journal of Thoracic Disease 2026 (GBD 2021)
source.quote: influenza LRTIs caused 27,615 [95% uncertainty interval (UI): 20,128-36,852] deaths and 2,460,833 (95% UI: 1,796,287-3,280,725) DALYs in children under five in 2021

rows.explainer: 27,615 deaths over 2,460,833 DALYs, 89 DALYs per death: every death is under five, so it is valued at the under-five weight. Used by charityevals' model of St. Jude's research.

rows.label: Share of sickle cell disease deaths under age 5, total mortality (GBD 2021, world)

source.title: Thomson et al. (GBD 2021 Sickle Cell Disease Collaborators), Global, regional, and national prevalence and mortality burden of sickle cell disease, 2000-2021, Lancet Haematology 2023
source.quote: total sickle cell disease mortality burden was nearly 11-times higher at 376 000 (303 000-467 000). In children younger than 5 years, there were 81 100 (58 800-108 000) deaths

rows.explainer: 81,100 of 376,000 deaths (total mortality, counting deaths sickle cell disease causes through infections and other conditions). The range is a judgment narrower than the intervals' crossed ends (58,800/467,000 = 0.13 to 108,000/303,000 = 0.36), since the two come from the same model and move together. Used by charityevals' model of St. Jude's research.

rows.label: Share of sickle cell deaths over age 5 that are at ages 5 to 14 (world)
rows.explainer: Our judgment: GBD 2021 publishes the under-five deaths (sickle_cell_share_under5_world) but not the rest by age in its summary; after them, most sickle cell deaths in sub-Saharan Africa come in childhood and young adulthood (median survival in the twenties at best), in the US at about 40-50. 25% at 5-14, the rest mostly 15-49. Used by charityevals' model of St. Jude's research (non-cancer branch) to value sickle cell deaths by age (@moral_weights; decision 2026-10-31 #4).

rows.label: Share of sickle cell deaths over age 15 that are at 50 or older (world)
rows.explainer: Our judgment: few patients in Africa and India reach 50; in the US and Europe life expectancy is in the forties to fifties. 12%. Used by charityevals' model of St. Jude's research (non-cancer branch) to value sickle cell deaths by age (@moral_weights; decision 2026-10-31 #4).

rows.label: Share of children's (under-five) influenza DALYs that are years lived with disability (world)
rows.explainer: Our judgment from GBD 2021's figures (Zhang et al. 2026): 27,615 deaths under five at about 88 years of life lost each (GBD's standard life expectancy) account for nearly all of the 2.46 million DALYs; about 1% is illness. Used by charityevals' model of St. Jude's research.

rows.label: Share of cardiovascular deaths at 70 or older that are at 80 or older (United Kingdom)
rows.explainer: Our judgment, to value the UK's cardiovascular deaths at 70 and over with GiveWell's five-year weights (70–74 and 75–79 against 80 and over; references: families/high-income-care.md): GBD's age groups stop at 70+, and in the UK most heart and stroke deaths come in the late 70s to 90s (life expectancy at 70 is about 15 years). 70%, 60% to 80%.

rows.label: Share of cardiovascular deaths at 70 or older that are at 80 or older (world)
rows.explainer: Our judgment, as for the UK figure: worldwide, deaths at 70 and over are younger than in the UK (shorter lives in the countries with most of the deaths). 45%, 35% to 55%.

rows.label: Share of smoking deaths at 70 or older that are at 80 or older (United Kingdom)
rows.explainer: Our judgment, as for the cardiovascular figure: smoking deaths (lung cancer, chronic lung disease, heart disease) come younger than cardiovascular deaths as a whole, since smokers die about ten years early. 50%, 40% to 60%.
